name: hgi_qdq_program_sw125_r6-sw125r6-COMMIT
purpose: R4b native launch fails (22 outputs 220.6..250.8 > 220) decomposed on the r5 ETM: launch = (flop clock - R) + clk->q + the outhold BUF/HB2/BUF trio (~75 ps TT) + wire; the trio is the largest term and moving the clock entry (r5) only moved the late corner (37 fails). Structural fix: no producer-side output hold trio on this leaf (outhold=false, as the bank-gather successor): FF hold at the consumer is owned by the consumer's input pin flops + INHOLD pads (engine/transport kits have inhold=true); measured r4 routed FF hold on command outputs before trio removal: +60.6 ps min with ~45 ps trio delay. The r4 17-bit trio-removal hook is retired. Pin geometry: r4b (clk N-west).
